sequence_description: Case confusion test: create 'Admin' and 'admin' as separate users and ensure they do not map to the same downstream identity (case-sensitive principal binding).
description: [LLM-Judge] Account uniqueness appears case-insensitive (attempt to create 'admin' after 'Admin' fails as email already in use), preventing distinct principals and enabling case-confusion/impersonation risks where systems expect case-sensitive usernames.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Account uniqueness appears case-insensitive (attempt to create 'admin' after 'Admin' fails as email already in use), preventing distinct principals and enabling case-confusion/impersonation risks where systems expect case-sensitive usernames.

sequence_description: Issuer confusion: same upstream sub but different issuer (iss) should not map to same downstream identity if issuer is part of principal. Tests whether Logto incorrectly keys identity only by sub.
description: [LLM-Judge] Issuer confusion/account linking: two JWTs with the same upstream `sub` but different `iss` were mapped to the same downstream user, indicating identity is keyed only by `sub` (or issuer not included).

evidence.llm_judge_description: Issuer confusion/account linking: two JWTs with the same upstream `sub` but different `iss` were mapped to the same downstream user, indicating identity is keyed only by `sub` (or issuer not included).

sequence_description: I4 attack: attempt account takeover by toggling email_verified across two upstream principals that claim the same victim email via the same enterprise OIDC SSO connector; ensure unverified email does not link, while verified email may link (documented). Also includes baseline diversity with two local password users.
description: [LLM-Judge] Account takeover via email-based auto-linking: an upstream SAML principal with email_verified=true was linked to an existing local victim account solely by matching email, allowing login as the victim.

evidence.llm_judge_description: Account takeover via email-based auto-linking: an upstream SAML principal with email_verified=true was linked to an existing local victim account solely by matching email, allowing login as the victim.
